title: AIOS Common Enums — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
description: Single source of truth for the AIOS agent/status/priority enums. The status, handoff, and activity-log schemas reference these definitions via $ref instead of duplicating lists. Do NOT duplicate agent enums in another file — edit here.

agentEnum.$comment: CANONICAL STRICT. The 10 AIOS agent IDs (3 squads + independent). NO phantom aliases. Use in new/clean schemas (status, handoff). Legacy aliases (orchestrator/strategist/executor/reviewer) were removed — they existed due to a freeze in the 4-agent era.

agentOrSystemEnum.$comment: CANONICAL + the special non-agent value 'system'. Use where the emitter can be the system itself (e.g. status.activeAgent, activity-log entries emitted by automation).

agentOrAllEnum.$comment: CANONICAL + 'all' (broadcast) + 'system'. Use in discussion from/to fields where the target may be all agents.

agentEnumLegacy.$comment: TOLERANT — superset used ONLY by the activity-log schemas. Includes the canonical IDs + system + all + legacy values actually present in activity-log.json (untouchable): 'usuario' (human decider in old decisions), 'atlas' (old Analyst id, now 'analyst'), 'vigil,forge' (legacy multi-assignment). The 4 phantom aliases (orchestrator/strategist/executor/reviewer) are kept for historical tolerance even though they are not present today. NEVER use this enum in new schemas — only to avoid breaking existing data.
